versions.changelog:
Initial release of secrets-inject, a companion to secrets-manager for high-risk secret injection into shell commands.

- Injects decrypted secrets from secrets-manager into shell command templates.
- Outputs executable temp scripts with secrets in plaintext (chmod 0600), or prints injected commands to stdout (with explicit confirmation).
- Tracks and manages temporary injection files; provides manual cleanup functionality.
- Requires elevated permissions for filesystem, environment, crypto, and command generation.
- Clearly separates hazardous secret-materialization logic from secrets-manager for safe, opt-in use.
